searched_classes: groundwater recharge and drainage application studies

criteria.quantity: cumulative annual discharge, locations with discharge >5 m3/s
cumulative annual discharge, locations with discharge <5 m3/s
cumulative summer-half-year supply, locations with supply >5 m3/s
cumulative summer-half-year supply, locations with supply <5 m3/s
cumulative annual discharge for larger regional water-balance areas

formal_downstream_system_authority.source_basis: The report states that criteria were adjusted in view of approximately 10-25% measurement-accuracy margins and adds a water-balance-area criterion for LHM 4.1.
formal_downstream_system_authority.rejection_reason: Surface-water discharge, supply and regional water-balance outputs integrate precipitation, evapotranspiration, storage change, groundwater exchange, drainage, routing and management. No independent mapping is supplied from an allowable downstream balance error to an allowable unsaturated-zone recharge or lower-boundary exchange error.

swap_validation_evidence.source: SWAP theory and user guide, verification and validation chapter
swap_validation_evidence.finding: SWAP validation examples include annual lysimeter drainage and evaporation and other hydrological state/flux comparisons, but no formal transferable recharge acceptance threshold is prescribed.

rejected_routes.route: Use LHM surface-water 25%, 33% or 50% cumulative criteria as recharge tolerance
rejected_routes.reason: Requires an independently governed attribution/response mapping that is absent.

rejected_routes.route: Use observed agreement in SWAP lysimeter drainage as acceptance threshold
rejected_routes.reason: Achieved validation performance is not a predeclared application requirement.

rejected_routes.route: Use numerical water-balance closure as recharge representation tolerance
rejected_routes.reason: Conservation/accounting accuracy and permissible hydrological model-form error are different error classes.

rejected_routes.route: Choose seasonal or annual aggregation because a Layer-ROM performs better there
rejected_routes.reason: Temporal support must be externally defined before candidate response.

frozen_envelope.terminal_statement: NO INDEPENDENT QUANTITATIVE APPLICATION AUTHORITY FOUND
